latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Generator Maker — generate videos from text or images for free.

- Users can create 1080p MP4 videos from text and/or image uploads in under 60 seconds, with no paid software required.
- Automatic setup: skill generates and manages free NEMO_TOKEN credentials.
- Handles file uploads (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, and more), credits checking, export status, and outputs ready-to-share videos.
- All video rendering runs on cloud GPU servers; nothing to install locally.
- Supports interactive edit workflows, timeline previews, and batch processing.
- Clear error handling for invalid tokens, session errors, file issues, and export limits.
